main.description: Represents the hold's ownership and metadata. Stored as a singleton record at rkey 'self' in the hold's embedded PDS.

allowAllCrew.description: Allow any authenticated user to register as crew

deployedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the hold was deployed

enableBlueskyPosts.description: Enable Bluesky posts when manifests are pushed

public.description: Whether this hold allows public blob reads (pulls) without authentication

region.description: S3 region where blobs are stored
